claims: Detroit Pistons lost to Orlando Magic 112-101 in Game 1 of their 2026 NBA playoff series on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
Cade Cunningham led the Detroit Pistons with 39 points in Game 1.
Game 2 is scheduled for Wednesday, April 22, at 7 p.m. ET at Little Caesars Arena.
Game 2 will be broadcast on ESPN.
Detroit Pistons enter the 2026 playoffs as the 1-seed.
Orlando Magic enter the 2026 playoffs as the 8-seed
